- `fn (string &$x) => ...` — the `&` is found as part of the `fn` signature → treated as unary reference, untouched
- `fn () => A & B` — the search hits `=>` first (body of the arrow function) → still correctly treated as a binary operator
- existing `function`/closure signature and body behavior is unchanged
